paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.94% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (+0.19%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.64%). Brent crude changed -0.05% to 102.26. Gold changed +0.39% to 4,218.6001. Bitcoin changed +3.55% to 86,521.1562. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.237%, a relative move of -1.06%. Among the firms tracked, Occidental (+4.56%) and Santander (-3.98%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: EG Group delays IPO plans and draws takeover interest (FT Companies). Petrol station empire had filed for New York listing aiming to raise about $1bn at $9bn valuation Deals and capital markets: Auditor RSM explores IPO to ward off private equity-backed rivals (FT Home). Accounting firm has been sounding out bankers and revamping internal systems to give itself the option of a stock market flotation Central banks and macro: Philippines’ central bank braces for ‘Godzilla’ El Niño (FT World). Severe Pacific Ocean weather event could fuel inflationary pressures and hit agricultural production across region Central banks and macro: Quant hedge funds reap big gains from global bond sell-off (FT World). Trend-following portfolios have latched on to sharp rise in yields this year as Iran war and strong US economic data fuel inflation fears Geopolitics and trade: PM warned Rosebank oil field could breach West Bank sanctions (BBC Business). Campaigners and Green Party leader Zack Polanski raise concerns about Rosebank's ties to an Israeli firm.
